summary: FAIL. The model and animation fixes that landed hold up when re-measured: Hesmi M1/M2, Sukri M2/M3, Marund M1/M3, Odrum M1/M2/crown, Tunlan pops and recall, Dunsom idle/recall. All 24 GLBs pass the three.js load test. But the cards were not re-staged for any of the 8 fighters, Ilsheta's skins were not rebuilt, the Rishal/Ilsheta motion fixes and the Rishal Lamplit rebuild are uncommitted by CW6, Dunsom's hat ramp is 8.2-9.1 L* (needs >= 10), and the Marund/Hesmi/Sukri effect halves are still in hand-off. Done criteria 4 and 5 fail outright.
method: Independent FK gauge _harness/_reports/fw_CW6_v1_fk.mjs (pairwise travel, 60 Hz step at a given playback rate, loop seam); node art/tools/three_load_test.mjs on 24 GLBs (--skin-only for skins); node art/tools/crown_gate.mjs art/out/fighters/odrum; Lab dE76 / chroma medians on three_* sheets (sRGB->Lab D65); fw_CW6_odrum_yoke.mjs re-run; every new render viewed.

items.evidence: Hesmi eye-band: _harness/_shots/fw_CW6_hesmi_eyes_3skins.png (viewed at x3) shows two dark glossy lenses, each with a small cool catch-light, and no block joint between brow and bridge. The icon at 128/48/26 px (fw_CW6_hesmi_band_icon.png) reads as a stern eye line, not teeth, horror or a mannequin. Minor: the catch-lights are 2-3 px at portrait scale and vanish at 26 px.

FK (fw_CW6_v1_fk.mjs, idle/recall/channel; head travel cm, loop seam cm): Dunsom idle 6.6 / recall 6 s 17.5 / seam 0; Ilsheta idle 7.8 / recall 6 s 12.8 / seam 0; Marund idle 8.2 / recall 6 s 23.2 / seam 0; Rishal idle 4.8 / recall 6 s 54.2 / channel 7.6 / seam 0; Tunlan idle 7.2 / recall 6 s 17.0 / seam 0. Every number clears 3.8 cm with no seam. Partly because: (a) every recall is 6 s inside RIFT's 7 s recall, so the opening replays for 1 s, a seamless but visible restart; (b) the Ilsheta and Rishal GLBs (13:26 / 13:32) landed only through wip sync 8b93ac40, the engineers claim not_done, and the brief beats were not reviewed by eye.
items.fixHint: Commit Ilsheta and Rishal under CW6 with their clip sheets, and view the recall beats against each brief. Optionally hold the last pose for the final 1 s, since a loop restart at t = 6 s reads as a repeat.
